<!-- Subjects Data -->

```{r}
# v_BMI_limits
DF_SUBJID_METADA_COMPLEX_DRUG <- read.csv("DF_SUBJID_METADA_COMPLEX_DRUG.CSV") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DRUG_COMPLEX=factor(DRUG_COMPLEX, levels = v_DRUG_COMPLEX_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ACTARMCD=factor(ACTARMCD, levels = v_ACTARMCD_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    bmi_label=case_when(
      bmi >= v_BMI_limits[1] & bmi< v_BMI_limits[2] ~ v_BMI_levels[1],
      bmi >= v_BMI_limits[2] & bmi< v_BMI_limits[3] ~ v_BMI_levels[2],
      bmi >= v_BMI_limits[3] & bmi< v_BMI_limits[4] ~ v_BMI_levels[3],
      bmi >= v_BMI_limits[4] & bmi< v_BMI_limits[5] ~ v_BMI_levels[4],
      bmi >= v_BMI_limits[5] & bmi< v_BMI_limits[6] ~ v_BMI_levels[5],
      .default = NA
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    bmi_label = factor(bmi_label, levels = v_BMI_levels)
  )

```

<!-- Taxa Abundance -->

```{r}
DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID <- read.csv("DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID.CSV") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ACTARMCD)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    DAV = case_when(
      str_detect(ACTARMCD, "D1") ~ "DAVD1",
      str_detect(ACTARMCD, "D2") ~ "DAVD2",
      .default = "NODAV"
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    DRUG_COMPLEX=str_replace_all(str_replace_all(ACTARMCD, "D2", ""), "D1", "")
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DRUG_COMPLEX = factor(DRUG_COMPLEX, levels = v_DRUG_COMPLEX_levels)) %>%  
  dplyr::mutate(DAV = factor(DAV, levels = v_DAV_levels))
```


```{r}
DF_SHANNON_BITS_BASELINE <- DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DAY == 1) %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, SUBJID, DAY) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_bits_Baseline = H_entropy_bits(bin_RelAbun)
  )

```


```{r}

get_flx_SUBJS_DATA <- function(DF_SUBJS_DATA){
  tmp_flx <- DF_SUBJS_DATA %>% 
    # dplyr::filter(DRUG_COMPLEX == str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp) %>%
    flextable::flextable() %>% 
    flextable::theme_zebra(
      odd_header = "#CFCFCF",
      odd_body = "#EFEFEF",
      even_header = "transparent",
      even_body = "transparent"
    ) %>% 
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9) %>%
    flextable::color(i= ~SEX == "F", j = ~SEX, color = "#dd1c77", part = "body") %>%
    flextable::color(i= ~SEX == "M", j = ~SEX, color = "#2c7fb8", part = "body") %>%
    flextable::color(j = ~bmi, color = scale_bmi_cm) %>% 
    flextable::merge_v(j = c("DRUG_COMPLEX", "ACTARMCD"))
  return(tmp_flx)
}
```

## Subjects Metadata {.tabset}




### Summary

```{r}
DF_SUBJID_METADA_COMPLEX_DRUG_w_SHANNON_BITS_BASELINE <- DF_SUBJID_METADA_COMPLEX_DRUG %>% 
  dplyr::select(-SHAPE, -COLOR, -DAVCOLOR) %>% 
  left_join(
    DF_SHANNON_BITS_BASELINE %>% dplyr::select(-DAY),
    by = c("DRUG_COMPLEX", "ACTARMCD", "SUBJID")
  )

DF_SUBJID_METADA_COMPLEX_DRUG_w_SHANNON_BITS_BASELINE_Stats_01 <- DF_SUBJID_METADA_COMPLEX_DRUG_w_SHANNON_BITS_BASELINE %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  # dplyr::select(-SEX) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("AGE", "height", "weight", "bmi", "H_bits_Baseline")) %>% 
  group_by(name, SEX) %>% 
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$value, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)

DF_SUBJID_METADA_COMPLEX_DRUG_w_SHANNON_BITS_BASELINE_Stats_01 %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(med.min_max = sprintf("%0.3g [%0.3g, %0.3g]", q50, min, max)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(SEX, name, med.min_max) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = SEX, values_from = med.min_max) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Male" = "M", "Female" = "F") %>%
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra()
```

## Richness

```{r}
DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN <- DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, SUBJID, DAY, sampleID) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    Richness = length(unique(bin_name))
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(ACTARMCD))

DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_Stats <- DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, DAY) %>% 
  nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Stats = map_df(data, ~ceor_stats(.$Richness, na.rm = TRUE) )
  ) %>%
  unnest(Stats) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-data)
```




### Completeness and Contamination thresholds comparisons {.tabset}

```{r}
# dplyr::filter(bin_completeness >= bin_completeness_thresh) %>%
  # dplyr::filter(bin_contamination <= bin_contamination_thresh) %>%

v_bin_completeness_thresh  <- c(0, 5, 10, 25, 50, 70, 80, 90)
v_bin_contamination_thresh <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 50, 100)

f_apply_tmp <- function(DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID, bin_completeness_thresh_ii, v_bin_contamination_thresh){
  
  df_tmp <- lapply(
    seq(1, length(v_bin_contamination_thresh)),
    function (jj) DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID %>% 
      dplyr::filter(bin_completeness >= bin_completeness_thresh_ii ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(bin_contamination <= v_bin_contamination_thresh[jj] ) %>%
      group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, SUBJID, DAY, sampleID) %>% 
      dplyr::summarise(
        Richness = length(unique(bin_name))
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
        bin_completeness_thresh  = bin_completeness_thresh_ii,
        bin_contamination_thresh = v_bin_contamination_thresh[jj]
      )
  ) %>% 
    bind_rows()
  return(df_tmp)
}


DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_w_THRESHOLD <- lapply(
  seq(1, length(v_bin_completeness_thresh)),
  function (ii) f_apply_tmp(DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID, v_bin_completeness_thresh[ii], v_bin_contamination_thresh)
) %>% 
  bind_rows()

```




```{r}
get_plt_Richness_thresholds <- function(str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp, str_DAV_tmp){
  lbl_x <- "Bin completeness threshold (%)"
  lbl_y <- "Richness"
  nv_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels <- setNames(str_replace_all(v_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels, "\n", "/"), v_DRUG_COMPLEX_levels)
  nv_DAV_labels <- setNames(v_DAV_labels, v_DAV_levels)
  lbl_title <- sprintf("%s %s", nv_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels[str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp], nv_DAV_labels[str_DAV_tmp] )

  plt_tmp <- DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_w_THRESHOLD %>% 
    dplyr::filter(DRUG_COMPLEX == str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(DAV == str_DAV_tmp) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(bin_contamination_thresh=factor(bin_contamination_thresh)) %>% 
    # pull(bin_completeness_thresh) %>% unique()
    ggplot( aes(x=bin_completeness_thresh, y=Richness, fill=bin_contamination_thresh, group=interaction(bin_completeness_thresh, bin_contamination_thresh)) ) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    # geom_jitter(width = 0.5, alpha=0.25) +
    facet_grid(DAY~.) + # , labeller = as_labeller(nv_labels_grid_tmp)
    labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, title = lbl_title) +
    # coord_cartesian(
    #   ylim = c(0, 6.2)
    # ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_w_THRESHOLD$bin_completeness_thresh)) +
    theme_bla +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 15)) +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA) )
  return(plt_tmp)
}


```




```{r, results='asis', fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp <- "Ct"
str_DAV_tmp <- "NODAV"
cat("#### ", str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp, " ", str_DAV_tmp)
cat("\n")
cat("\n")
```

```{r}

v_bin_completeness_thresh  <- c(0, 5, 10, 25, 50, 70, 80, 90)
v_bin_contamination_thresh <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 50, 100)

f_apply_tmp <- function(DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID, bin_completeness_thresh_ii, v_bin_contamination_thresh){
  
  df_tmp <- lapply(
    seq(1, length(v_bin_contamination_thresh)),
    function (jj) DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID %>% 
      dplyr::filter(bin_completeness >= bin_completeness_thresh_ii ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(bin_contamination <= v_bin_contamination_thresh[jj] ) %>%
      group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, SUBJID, DAY, sampleID) %>% 
      dplyr::summarise(
        H_bits = H_entropy_bits(bin_RelAbun)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
        bin_completeness_thresh  = bin_completeness_thresh_ii,
        bin_contamination_thresh = v_bin_contamination_thresh[jj]
      )
  ) %>% 
    bind_rows()
  # df_tmp <- DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID %>% 
  #   dplyr::filter(bin_completeness >= bin_completeness_thresh_ii ) %>%
  #   dplyr::filter(bin_contamination <= bin_contamination_thresh_jj ) %>%
  #   group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, SUBJID, DAY, sampleID) %>% 
  #   dplyr::summarise(
  #     H_bits = H_entropy_bits(bin_RelAbun)
  #   ) %>% 
  #   ungroup() %>% 
  #   dplyr::mutate(
  #     bin_completeness_thresh  = bin_completeness_thresh_ii,
  #     bin_contamination_thresh = bin_contamination_thresh_jj
  #   )
  return(df_tmp)
}


DF_SHANNON_bits_SHTGN_w_THRESHOLD <- lapply(
  seq(1, length(v_bin_completeness_thresh)),
  function (ii) f_apply_tmp(DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID, v_bin_completeness_thresh[ii], v_bin_contamination_thresh)
) %>% 
  bind_rows()

```


```{r}
get_plt_Shannon_thresholds <- function(str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp, str_DAV_tmp){
  lbl_x <- "Bin completeness threshold (%)"
  lbl_y <- "Shannon Index (bits)"
  nv_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels <- setNames(str_replace_all(v_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels, "\n", "/"), v_DRUG_COMPLEX_levels)
  nv_DAV_labels <- setNames(v_DAV_labels, v_DAV_levels)
  lbl_title <- sprintf("%s %s", nv_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels[str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp], nv_DAV_labels[str_DAV_tmp] )

  plt_tmp <- DF_SHANNON_bits_SHTGN_w_THRESHOLD %>% 
    dplyr::filter(DRUG_COMPLEX == str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(DAV == str_DAV_tmp) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(bin_contamination_thresh=factor(bin_contamination_thresh)) %>% 
    # pull(bin_completeness_thresh) %>% unique()
    ggplot( aes(x=bin_completeness_thresh, y=H_bits, fill=bin_contamination_thresh, group=interaction(bin_completeness_thresh, bin_contamination_thresh)) ) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    # geom_jitter(width = 0.5, alpha=0.25) +
    facet_grid(DAY~.) + # , labeller = as_labeller(nv_labels_grid_tmp)
    labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, title = lbl_title) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 6.2)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(DF_SHANNON_bits_SHTGN_w_THRESHOLD$bin_completeness_thresh)) +
    theme_bla +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 15)) +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA) )
  return(plt_tmp)
}


```

```{r}
df_full_table_final_MAG_flag_02 <- df_full_table_final_MAG_flag %>%
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    bin_RelAbun_NOMAGs = bin_abundance/sum(bin_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    bin_RelAbun_MAGs   = ifelse(b_MAG, bin_abundance/sum(bin_abundance[b_MAG], na.rm = TRUE), NA)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID = str_replace_all(sample, "D", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID = str_replace_all(sampleID, "_", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sampleID = str_replace_all(sampleID, "R", ".R")) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(
    DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID %>% 
      dplyr::select(ACTARMCD, SUBJID, DAY, sampleID) %>% 
      distinct() %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(DRUG_COMPLEX = str_replace_all(str_replace_all(ACTARMCD, "D2", ""), "D1", "") ) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(DAV = case_when(
        str_detect(ACTARMCD, "D1") ~ "DAVD1",
        str_detect(ACTARMCD, "D2") ~ "DAVD2",
        !(str_detect(ACTARMCD, "D1") | str_detect(ACTARMCD, "D2")) ~ "NODAV",
        .default = NA
      ) ),
    by=c("sampleID")
  )
  # group_by(sample, b_MAG) %>%  
  # dplyr::mutate(
  #   bin_RelAbun_MAGs   = ifelse(b_MAG, bin_abundance/sum(bin_abundance[b_MAG], NA), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# dplyr::filter(bin_completeness >= bin_completeness_thresh) %>%
  # dplyr::filter(bin_contamination <= bin_contamination_thresh) %>%

v_bin_completeness_thresh  <- c(0, 5, 10, 25, 50, 70, 80, 90)
v_bin_contamination_thresh <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 50, 100)

f_apply_tmp <- function(DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID, bin_completeness_thresh_ii, v_bin_contamination_thresh){
  
  df_tmp <- lapply(
    seq(1, length(v_bin_contamination_thresh)),
    function (jj) DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID_w_RESIST %>% 
      dplyr::filter(bin_completeness >= bin_completeness_thresh_ii ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(bin_contamination <= v_bin_contamination_thresh[jj] ) %>%
      group_by( DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, ACTARMCD, DAY, SUBJID, sampleID) %>% 
      summarise(
        n_TZP_R = sum(TZP_R == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_CTX_R = sum(CTX_R == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_CZA_R = sum(CZA_R == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
        bin_completeness_thresh  = bin_completeness_thresh_ii,
        bin_contamination_thresh = v_bin_contamination_thresh[jj]
      )
  ) %>% 
    bind_rows()
  return(df_tmp)
}


DF_N_RESIST_SUBJID_w_THRESHOLD <- lapply(
  seq(1, length(v_bin_completeness_thresh)),
  function (ii) f_apply_tmp(DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID, v_bin_completeness_thresh[ii], v_bin_contamination_thresh)
) %>% 
  bind_rows()

```

### TZP Compleness and Contamination {.tabset}


```{r}
get_plt_N_RESIST_TZP_R_thresholds <- function(str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp, str_DAV_tmp){
  lbl_x <- "Bin completeness threshold (%)"
  lbl_y <- "Number of TZP Resistant genes per subject"
  nv_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels <- setNames(str_replace_all(v_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels, "\n", "/"), v_DRUG_COMPLEX_levels)
  nv_DAV_labels <- setNames(v_DAV_labels, v_DAV_levels)
  lbl_title <- sprintf("%s %s", nv_DRUG_COMPLEX_labels[str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp], nv_DAV_labels[str_DAV_tmp] )

  plt_tmp <- DF_N_RESIST_SUBJID_w_THRESHOLD %>% 
    dplyr::filter(DRUG_COMPLEX == str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(DAV == str_DAV_tmp) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(bin_contamination_thresh=factor(bin_contamination_thresh)) %>% 
    # pull(bin_completeness_thresh) %>% unique()
    ggplot( aes(x=bin_completeness_thresh, y=n_TZP_R, fill=bin_contamination_thresh, color=bin_contamination_thresh, group=interaction(bin_completeness_thresh, bin_contamination_thresh)) ) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    # geom_jitter(width = 0.5, alpha=0.25) +
    facet_grid(DAY~.) + # , labeller = as_labeller(nv_labels_grid_tmp)
    labs(x=lbl_x, y=lbl_y, title = lbl_title) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 6.2)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(DF_N_RESIST_SUBJID_w_THRESHOLD$bin_completeness_thresh)) +
    theme_bla +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank()) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black', size = 15)) +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA) )
  return(plt_tmp)
}


```



```{r, results='asis', fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp <- "Ct"
str_DAV_tmp <- "NODAV"
cat("#### ", str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp, " ", str_DAV_tmp)
cat("\n")
cat("\n")

print(plt_tmp)
cat("\n")
cat("\n")
```

```{r, results='asis', fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
  cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
  plt_tmp <- get_plt_N_RESIST_TZP_R_thresholds(str_DRUG_COMPLEX_tmp, str_DAV_tmp)

}
```

```{r}

v_DAY_levels <- c(1, 6, 37)

get_Richeness_wilcox_pvalue <- function(int_DAY_1, int_DAY_2, df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP){
  b_DAY_1 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_1) %>% nrow() > 0
  b_DAY_2 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_2) %>% nrow() > 0
  if ( b_DAY_1 & b_DAY_2 ){
    p.value <- wilcox.test(
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_1) %>% pull(Richness),
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_2) %>% pull(Richness),
      correct = FALSE
    )$p.value
  }else{
    p.value <- NA
  }
  return(p.value)
}

int_DAY_TMP_1 <- 1
int_DAY_TMP_2 <- 6

DF_RICHNESS_p.value_A <- DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_w_FINAL_THRESHOLD %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV) %>% 
  do(pvalue = get_Richeness_wilcox_pvalue(int_DAY_TMP_1, int_DAY_TMP_2, .) ) %>% 
  unnest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY_1 = int_DAY_TMP_1, DAY_2 = int_DAY_TMP_2)


int_DAY_TMP_1 <- 1
int_DAY_TMP_2 <- 37

DF_RICHNESS_p.value_B <- DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_w_FINAL_THRESHOLD %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV) %>% 
  do(pvalue = get_Richeness_wilcox_pvalue(int_DAY_TMP_1, int_DAY_TMP_2, .) ) %>% 
  unnest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY_1 = int_DAY_TMP_1, DAY_2 = int_DAY_TMP_2)


int_DAY_TMP_1 <- 6
int_DAY_TMP_2 <- 37

DF_RICHNESS_p.value_C <- DF_RICHNESS_SHTGN_w_FINAL_THRESHOLD %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV) %>% 
  do(pvalue = get_Richeness_wilcox_pvalue(int_DAY_TMP_1, int_DAY_TMP_2, .) ) %>% 
  unnest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY_1 = int_DAY_TMP_1, DAY_2 = int_DAY_TMP_2)


DF_RICHNESS_p.value <- bind_rows(
  list(
    DF_RICHNESS_p.value_A,
    DF_RICHNESS_p.value_B,
    DF_RICHNESS_p.value_C
  )
) %>% dplyr::mutate(
    DAY_1 = factor(DAY_1, levels=v_DAY_levels),
    DAY_2 = factor(DAY_2, levels=v_DAY_levels)
  )
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
  group_by(DAY, DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, id_gene, Resist_to, Resist) %>% 
  summarise(
    bin_abundance.mean = mean(bin_abundance),
    bin_RelAbun.mean = mean(bin_RelAbun),

    bin_RelAbun_baseline.mean = mean(bin_RelAbun_baseline)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_point(aes(x=bin_RelAbun.mean/bin_RelAbun_baseline.mean, y=id_gene, shape=Resist_to, color=Resist_to), alpha=0.5, size=3) +
```

```{r}
get_wilcox_pvalue <- function(int_DAY_1, int_DAY_2, df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP){
  b_DAY_1 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_1) %>% nrow() > 0
  b_DAY_2 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_2) %>% nrow() > 0
  if ( b_DAY_1 & b_DAY_2 ){
    p.value <- wilcox.test(
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_1) %>% pull(MAG_w_betalactamase_RelAbun),
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_2) %>% pull(MAG_w_betalactamase_RelAbun),
      correct = FALSE
    )$p.value
  }else{
    p.value <- NA
  }
  return(p.value)
}


int_DAY_TMP_1 <- 1
int_DAY_TMP_2 <- 6

DF_TMPTMP_p.value_A <- DF_TAXA_ABUNDANCE_w_ID_THRESH_FINAL_w_RESGEN_YES_MAG_RELABUN_TMP %>% 
  group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV) %>% 
  do(pvalue = get_wilcox_pvalue(int_DAY_TMP_1, int_DAY_TMP_2, .) ) %>% 
  unnest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY_1 = int_DAY_TMP_1, DAY_2 = int_DAY_TMP_2)

# DF_TMPTMP.value_A %>% dplyr::filter(pvalue < 0.05)

int_DAY_TMP_2 <- 37

  unnest() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(DAY_1 = int_DAY_TMP_1, DAY_2 = int_DAY_TMP_2)


int_DAY_TMP_1 <- 6

  do(pvalue = get_wilcox_pvalue(int_DAY_TMP_1, int_DAY_TMP_2, .) ) %>%

DF_TMPTMP_p.value <- bind_rows(
```

```{r}
get_wilcox_pvalue <- function(int_DAY_1, int_DAY_2, df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP){
  b_DAY_1 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_1) %>% nrow() > 0
  b_DAY_2 <- df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_2) %>% nrow() > 0
  if ( b_DAY_1 & b_DAY_2 ){
    p.value <- wilcox.test(
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_1) %>% pull(MAG_w_betalactamase_RelAbun),
      df_4_mnlx_tmp_TMP %>% dplyr::filter(DAY == int_DAY_2) %>% pull(MAG_w_betalactamase_RelAbun),
      correct = FALSE
    )$p.value
  }else{
    p.value <- NA
  }
  return(p.value)
}
```

```{r}
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Gene id" ="id_gene") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Class" = "gene_ref_pcm_predict") %>%

  dplyr::rename("Resistant to.CTX" = "CTX_R") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Resistant to.CZA" = "CZA_R") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("MIC.TZP" = "TZP_MIC") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("MIC.CTX" = "CTX_MIC") %>% 
  dplyr::rename("MIC.CZA" = "CZA_MIC") %>% 
  DT::datatable(filter="top")
```

### Summary By Resistance


Summary: we ended up with 
xx MAGs harbouring a beta-lactamase active against CRO, xx against TZP and xx against CZA (provide a Table ?)


```{r}
DF_RESGENE_BETALACTAMASES_02 %>% 
  dplyr::select(DAY, bin_name, CTX_R, CZA_R, TZP_R) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CTX_R = str_replace(CTX_R, "A_", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CZA_R = str_replace(CZA_R, "A_", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(TZP_R = str_replace(TZP_R, "A_", "")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=c("CTX_R", "CZA_R", "TZP_R"), values_to = "Resist", names_to = "Resist_to") %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  group_by(DAY, Resist_to, Resist) %>% 
  summarise(n_MAGs = length(bin_name)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Resist, values_from = n_MAGs) %>% 
  flextable::flextable() %>% 
  flextable::theme_zebra() #%>% 
  # flextable::save_as_html(path="tablita.html")

```


```{r}
DF_RESGENE_BETALACTAMASES_02 %>% 
  dplyr::select(DAY, bin_name, CTX_R, CZA_R, TZP_R) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CTX_R = str_replace(CTX_R, "A_", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CZA_R = str_replace(CZA_R, "A_", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(TZP_R = str_replace(TZP_R, "A_", "")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=c("CTX_R", "CZA_R", "TZP_R"), values_to = "Resist", names_to = "Resist_to") %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>%

  summarise(n_MAGs = length(bin_name)) %>%
```

```{r}
DF_RESGENE_BETALACTAMASES_DAYZ_6_37 %>% 
  # dplyr::mutate(TZP_R = factor(TZP_R, levels = v_Resistance_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, SUBJID, id_gene, DAY, contains("bin_RelAbun"), contains("bin_abundance"), CTX_R, CZA_R, TZP_R, gene_ref_pcm_predict, bin_name) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=c("CTX_R", "CZA_R", "TZP_R"), values_to = "Resist", names_to = "Resist_to") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Resist_to = str_replace_all(Resist_to, "_R", "")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Resist = factor(Resist, levels = v_Resistance_levels)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(increase_factor = ifelse( is.na(bin_RelAbun_baseline) , Inf, bin_RelAbun/bin_RelAbun_baseline ) ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-id_gene, -bin_RelAbun, -bin_RelAbun_baseline, -bin_abundance, -bin_abundance_baseline) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(b_increase = increase_factor > 1) %>% 
  # group_by(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, DAY, Resist_to, Resist, b_increase) %>% 
  group_by(DAY, Resist_to, Resist, b_increase) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_MAGs = length(bin_name)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(DAY, Resist_to, Resist) %>% 
  summarise(
    n_MAGS.increased = sum(n_MAGs[b_increase]),
    n_MAGS.total = sum(n_MAGs)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Antibiotic" = "Resist_to") 
  
  # dplyr::select(DRUG_COMPLEX, DAV, SUBJID, bin_name )
  # colnames()
```
